name: The Remnant of Argon
summary: This article is about the location. For the quest, see The Remnant of Argon (quest). The Remnant of Argon is a magical refuge hidden inside a powerful Argonian relic. The Remnant was created by the elders of the Root-Whisper Tribe to provide safe harbor from the invading Barsaebic Ayleid forces. As you assist Cyrodilic Collections in Murkmire and discover the truth about the Remnant, you will also be given the opportunity to travel inside the relic itself and help free the spirits trapped within. When you enter the relic, the interior takes the form of a lush but unchanging jungle. It is filled with Argonian Spirits, including the spirits of Tsixotl and Sap-Speaker Kuzei.
